'''Testament Day''' was a [[holiday]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] society. It was held every twenty-five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on the day of anniversary of the Tribe's first [[Grand Lord]], [[Yaru Korsin]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]], in the office of the [[Caretaker]]. It consisted of a lecture of the final testament of Korsin in person.
